text: On a dartboard, which number sits at the very top, between the 5 and the 1?
why: The board runs 20, 1, 18, 4… from the top, with the 5 on the other side of the 20.

text: Ellie finished the Great North Run before Jo, but after Kim. Who finished first?
Which is bigger: a third of ninety, or a quarter of a hundred?
why: A third of 90 is 30; a quarter of 100 is 25.

text: A train leaves Newcastle at 10:47 and takes 2 hours 55 minutes to reach London. What time does it arrive?
How many times does the letter E appear in NEWCASTLE UPON TYNE?
why: NEWCASTLE has two, UPON has none, TYNE has one.

text: Sausage rolls cost £1.20 each. How much do five of them cost?
Going clockwise round a compass from North, the points are N, E, S… then?
why: The points of the compass, going clockwise from North.

text: Multiply a hexagon's sides by a spider's legs, then subtract the players in one football team. What's the result?
Sunderland is 12 miles from Newcastle. A cyclist rides there and back at 12 mph. How many minutes does the round trip take?
why: 24 miles at 12 miles an hour is 2 hours: 120 minutes.

text: A £40 coat goes up by 10%, then the new price is cut by 10%. What does it cost now?
A year that isn't a leap year starts on a Saturday. How many Saturdays does it have?
why: 365 days is 52 weeks and 1 day, and that extra day is a Saturday.
